_description: Single source of truth for the CoinCync testnet fleet topology. Every node in `nodes` has every other node added to its --addnode dial list via scripts/render-systemd-unit.sh + scripts/sync-fleet-config.sh. When a node is added, removed, or has its IP changed: (1) edit this file, (2) keep TESTNET_SEED_NODES (src/testnet.rs) and TESTNET_FALLBACK (src/network/dns_seeds.rs) in sync with the seed/relay-role entries here, (3) run scripts/sync-fleet-config.sh, (4) verify every node converges. See docs/operations/fleet-config.md for the runbook.

_deploy_guard: deploy/fleet/safe-deploy.sh refuses to install a binary onto the fleet unless its `coincync-node --version` runs cleanly (no segfault) AND prints a testnet consensus fingerprint equal to `expected_consensus_fingerprint_testnet` below. It also takes a per-host advisory lock (/run/coincync-deploy.lock) so two operators/sessions can't stomp each other. Bump the expected fingerprint ONLY on an intentional consensus relaunch, in the same commit that changes the locked consensus files.
_rpc_bind_policy: Per-host RPC bind address. 127.0.0.1 means loopback-only (RPC only reachable from localhost; safer default; assumes nginx or stunnel for any public exposure). 0.0.0.0 means listen on all interfaces (public RPC). Keep loopback unless the host is intentionally serving public RPC behind nginx.

community_seeds._description: Reachable public nodes run by community members, NOT owned or controlled by the project. OK to point a DNS seed record at them and to --addnode them once verified (inbound-reachable + on the canonical chain), but do NOT hardcode them into TESTNET_SEED_NODES / TESTNET_FALLBACK — DNS is revocable, the baked-in binary fallback must stay project-owned.
